x.author: Thibault Sottiaux
x.summary: OpenAI 团队成员 Thibault Sottiaux 表示，未来数天内将有数百万个“Dot”（个性化 AI 智能体）上线上线服务。他指出 Dot 在经过 2-3 天的学习和适应用户偏好后能力会有质的飞跃，甚至能自主承担高难度的复杂任务。团队目前正观察用户对“主 Dot”的使用反馈，后续将开放创建完整 Dot 团队（多智能体协作）的功能。
x.translation:
在接下来的几天里，将有数百万个 Dot 上线，在这个庞大而多元的社区中处理各种事务。

非常期待从大家那里了解你们喜欢什么，以及哪些地方还不够“神奇”。就我个人而言，在向它输入了更多我的偏好和近期关注的事物后，使用 2 到 3 天就能明显感觉到能力的飞跃。它能极快地学习以发挥最大作用，并且能够独立承担令人惊喜的大胆任务。

在允许大家创建完整的 Dot 团队之前，我们正在通过观察你们如何使用各自的“主 Dot”来积累经验。

在 DevDay 上能与大家面对面交流真是太棒了。现场氛围绝佳，看到大家整天都在动手构建新东西非常有意思。
x.recommendation: 这透露了 OpenAI 在智能体（Agent）领域的最新落地形态——从单个“个性化智能体”通过偏好持续演进，再扩展到“多智能体团队”协同。对于关注 AI Agent 架构、上下文记忆以及多智能体协作的开发者和从业者来说，这一演进路线非常值得关注和借鉴。

rawTweets.text:
We will have a few million dots online within days, working on all sorts of things across such a diverse and large community. 

Excited to learn from all of you on what you love and what doesn’t yet feel magical. Personally I felt a jump after 2-3 days of use after teaching it more about my preferences and things on my mind. It learns very quickly to be most useful and it can take on surprisingly ambitious tasks on its own.

We’re learning from how you all use your primary dot before releasing the ability to create an entire team of them.
It was so nice to connect with so many of you in person at DevDay. Immaculate vibes from the crowd and fun to see so many build things throughout the day.

x.summary: Peter Yang 分享了他参加 OpenAI Dev Day 的真实体验，相比听讲座，他更倾向于与 AI 领域的顶级创作者、产品领袖及投资人进行线下交流。同时，他对 YouTube 上泛滥的低质 AI 生成短视频（AI Slop Shorts）表达了强烈不满，呼吁 YouTube CEO 允许用户彻底关闭 Shorts 功能，并分享了相关的屏蔽技巧。
x.translation:
[推文 1] 哇，我完全不知道居然有这个开关。我决定现在就试试，我真的太讨厌 YouTube 上那些垃圾 AI 短视频（AI slop shorts）了。

[推文 2] 虽然除了主题演讲外我一场分论坛都没听，但在 OpenAI Dev Day 上我依然玩得非常开心 😅。相反，我把整天时间都花在和一些超棒的朋友叙旧上了，所以我现在要公开“点名”其中几位：1. @lennysan，我极其荣幸能结交的最友善、最谦逊的成功人士；2. @bb_fresh，喜剧界传奇，在 YouTube 上搜索“krazam microservices”就能收获快乐。我的梦想就是作为产品经理出演 Ben 的搞笑短剧；3. @danshipper，氛围感绝了；4. @bentossell，这位穿粉色衣服的高个子威尔士绅士，写出了极棒的科技周报 Ben's Bites；5. @thenanyu，从 Linear 到 OpenAI，将品味和精湛工艺融入他所接触的每件事的人；6. @illscience，我见过的最喜欢的 a16z 合伙人（因为 @joshelman 还没跟我线下面基过 😅）；7. @fishmanaf，一位优秀的产品领袖，但更重要的是他是有史以来最强壮的爸爸；8. @tomkrcha，我最喜欢的 AI 设计工具之一 @pendev 的创始人；9. @victornunez，尽管在 OpenAI 工作且养育着 3 个孩子，却依然会在晚上 11 点抽空回复我那些愚蠢的私信。

x.author: Nikunj Kothari
x.role: partner @fpvventures - investing in seed/A. previous: early hire @meter, @opendoor, @atlassian & others. love @shimoleejhaveri + 👦👧
x.summary: Nikunj Kothari 近期分享了关于技术与产品的最新动态，重点涉及技术路线、产品进展与一线实践思考。
x.translation:
Two random honest thoughts on the market right now..

First is on people: It's harder than ever to find missionaries. I'm seeing people leave the companies they have cofounded to join the "obvious" winners. Public CEOs are leaving for positions at labs. Founders leaving and rejoining neolabs at a moment's notice. Companies getting Windsurf-ed where only the choice people are getting to join the future company. Founders raising tranched valuations without worrying about the next employee that will join them will have 409As that make early exercising impossible. 

As early stage VCs, we are often just betting on people. And, when those people leave on a dime's notice, then the remaining company (usually) becomes a shell. It seems like a great time to be a mercenary, and everyone feels like one even though there are missionaries out there. 

Second is on defensibility: There's a lot of chatter on moats, so I won't re-litigate the matter here. But the thing that I want to call out is given the pace of what's happening the moat is no longer "one" thing. Like if you really think about it especially in the app layer - the harness is like a thousand small things done well. And, a lot of it is invisible. And given the competition is so fierce and new entrants overnight, you really have to dig into the details to figure out why a given company is different. What is their edge, and their combined edge across product, tech and GTM. 

And often times even with that, you end up going back to "well the real defensibility is the founders". And in those founders the defensibility is their speed of execution and being able to adapt to the market. That has become the new bar for every founder out there, given there are no "blue ocean" markets. And even if there are, any company with a LITTLE bit of heat, will have a lot of competitiors overnight. 

Even though I think I have a pretty good sense on finding the best people who have founder market fit, I find this current climate really hard and it's testing all my priors (and patience) at the same time. 

I know it's not true, but feels like everyone is in it to grab the bag and not really care about their legacy of what they want to build (please reach out if you do).

Transitioning from one thing to the next can often be really fun and often quite stressful in what feels like a warp speed period.. 

If that’s you, @lolawajs & I would love to meet you at this breakfast and help in any way possible. 

DMs open! https://t.co/ApkXVmfrfE

If you’re a B2B founder and don’t want to spend egregious amounts of money on LinkedIn CPMs, 

lots of alpha in just aggregating what’s trending on X and posting it on LinkedIn. 

LinkedIn is consistently a week or two behind and they lap it up. 

And for those who think it’s cringe, you live long enough to start LinkedInfluencing. 

It truly comes for us all 🤷‍♂️
x.recommendation: 作为 Nikunj Kothari 的一手动态，展示了一线 Builder 的最新思考与产品探索，具备较高的行业参考价值。

blogs.title: Claude in Chrome is generally available
blogs.summary: Claude Blog 发布了关于「Claude in Chrome is generally available 」的技术博文，详细阐述了其工程实践与前沿设计方案。
blogs.translation: Claude in Chrome is now generally available on every paid Claude plan. Claude can now also take actions autonomously in the browser, instead of needing approval for every one. A safety classifier validates each action before it’s performed to ensure it’s safe and matches your request. Many of the tools you use every day connect to Claude . But many others don’t, such as internal dashboards, legacy systems, and vendor portals. Claude in Chrome lets Claude access those. It can view the page you’re on and take actions like reading and typing text, clicking links, navigating between pages, and filling out forms, using your existing logins. We first announced Claude in Chrome as a pilot last year, so we could test it while also shoring up our defenses against prompt injection : malicious instru...
blogs.recommendation: 官方技术博客通常代表了顶尖团队的第一手工程范式，推荐从事相关技术架构与 AI 研发的同学阅读。

githubTrending.name: VoiceStudio
githubTrending.title: VoiceStudio：全本地运行的开源 ElevenLabs 替代品，涵盖语音克隆与多语种配音
githubTrending.summary: VoiceStudio 旨在解决商业语音 API 成本高、依赖云端及数据隐私泄露的痛点。作为一款完全本地运行的开源语音 AI 工作站，它无需依赖任何外部接口，即可提供零样本声音克隆、声音设计、视频自动配音、语音听写、ASR 转写及有声书创作等全流程功能。系统基于 Python 深度整合主流 TTS 与 ASR 模型，原生支持多达 646 种语言。极其适合音视频内容创作者、出海团队以及对隐私敏感的本地化 AI 语音应用场景。
githubTrending.translation: VoiceStudio 是一款完全本地化运行的开源 ElevenLabs 替代方案，提供涵盖 646 种语言的声音克隆、声音设计、视频配音、语音听写、音频转写及有声书创作等全套功能。
githubTrending.recommendation: 单日暴涨超 4,700 Star 显现出市场对私有化 AI 语音引擎的极高热情。对于寻求离线语音生成与多语言配音解法的开发者而言，该项目绝对不容错过。
